source.quote: Based on what we are seeing, we expect to finish the year with GAAP diluted earnings per share ranging from -$0.10 to earnings of $0.30, and adjusted EBITDA to finish the year between $260 million and $280 million.
We expect full-year adjusted core EPS to range from $4-$4.50 per share, implying fourth-quarter adjusted core EPS of $0.90-$1.40.
Our fourth-quarter expectations incorporate the impact of the twoclass EPS calculation method and an assumed effective tax rate in the low to mid-teens.

Jade, I think first, obviously we gave the expectation that the actions that we've already initiated are going to give us about $20 million of operating income lift, which will be realized on a run rate basis by the middle of next year.
